subject: llvm-g++-4.7 linker errors on multivariate stuff

messages.author: 743bbacc59f4b25f
messages.subject: llvm-g++-4.7 linker errors on multivariate stuff
parts:
llvm-g++-4.6 is working now that the issue with the sign() function has been circumvented. However, llvm-g++-4.7 has an unrelated issue

goodrich@CYBERPOWERPC:/opt/stan$ make clean-all && make O=2 CC=llvm-g++-4.7 -j1  test/agrad/distributions/multivariate/continuous/inv_wishart
...

collect2: error: ld returned 1 exit status
make: *** [test/agrad/distributions/multivariate/continuous/inv_wishart] Error 1

However, the inv_wishart test with doubles passes, suggesting that it may be a bug with Eigen's handling of custom types, our specification of vars, or a compiler bug (since this is working and essentially always has with other compilers, including llvm-g++-4.6). Nor is the problem limited to inv_wishart but seems to affect wishart, multi_normal, etc. However, the problems go away at -O0.

Googling for " __atomic_fetch_add_4" turns up some hits where other people have gotten a similar error message in various situations, but it is never fully explained what they did about it.

Ben
